cards.intuition: Treat meaningful updates as arrivals with an average rate. Longer time since verification raises the chance at least one arrived.
Observed changes per exposure time are noisy for new pages, so blend them with a prior from similar source and page classes.
Ads and deployment bytes can change while useful content does not. Use normalized content signals to drive recrawl learning.
cards.formula: raw hash diagnoses transport; semantic hash drives index update

cards.intuition: Favor pages likely to have changed, costly to leave stale, and cheap to verify. Age alone is not value.
Choose only hosts whose politeness timer permits work, then choose that host's highest-value URL. Backoff failures independently.
cards.formula: eligible host queue → per-host priority frontier

cards.intuition: A fast fetch can still wait hours for extraction or indexing. Measure change-to-detection, extraction, index, and serving timestamps separately.
cards.formula: freshness lag = detect + process + index + publish lag

cards.intuition: A half-life expresses how quickly time signal fades without imposing a cliff.

cards.intuition: Let topical relevance remain primary and increase time weight only for freshness-intent queries on compatible score scales.

cards.intuition: Publication, semantic update, effective date, and crawl time answer different questions. Freshly fetched ancient content is still ancient.
cards.formula: rank with trusted content or effective timestamp, not default crawl time

cards.intuition: Historical and versioned queries need the requested effective period, while evergreen reference may need no time boost.
